note: true_cfg_scale 1 (one transformer pass per step), use_kv_cache on (extract at step 0, cached after). Latents are packed (tokens, channels), token = h * latent_w + w. step_latents[i] = latents after scheduler step i (native scheduler: float32 sigmas, float32 sample inside step()). decoded = vae.decode output in [-1,1] (RGBA, (C,H,W)); image = pipeline output_type='pt', i.e. decoded / 2 + 0.5 clamped to [0,1].
